findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The baffles of the ice machine was observed with mold and soil accumulation. The PIC was made aware. The PIC assured inspector that the accumulation will be cleaned and the baffles sanitized. Ensure food contact surfaces such as the ice machine baffles are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices.
findings.comment: Inspector observed leakage in the faucet of the triple sink and the hand sink on the cook line. The PIC was made aware. The PIC assured inspector that the necessary repairs will be done. Ensure that the sinks mentioned are repaired according to the LAW.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.15(A) System Maintained in Good Repair. A plumbing system shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The nudo board coating on the wall left of the hand sink at the entrance of the dish room was observed coming off the wall. Discussed with the PIC. The PIC assured inspector that the board will be sealed appropriately. Ensure that the gap is sealed providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.16(B) Wall and Ceiling Coverings and Coatings. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface.
